messages:
sophia: heads-up — drafting release notes for Fri 10pm PT change window. need final copy for internal blast + rollback table. skipping public blog for this patch. @eric @liam can you review snippets? link: https://docs.internal/rn-draft

eric: on it. quick Q: are we pinning model v2.3.1 or rolling forward to 2.4-beta for canary?

liam: prefer pin to 2.3.1 for stability. 2.4-beta stays behind feature flag. :thumbsup:

agnes: ops note — we'll reserve extra dedicated nodes during the window (reserved capacity +20%). deploying at 22:00 PT, 30m canary, then full. ok?

maria: copy suggestion for notes: "Fixed race in cache compaction causing intermittent 500s; improved request coalescing for long prompts." keep short.

sophia: adding that. draft snippet below — please react with :thumbsup: if okay or inline edit.

sophia: ```
Release notes (internal):
- Fix: race condition in cache compaction that caused intermittent 500s during high KV load.
- Improvement: improved request coalescing and batching heuristics for long prompts to reduce tail latency.
- Ops: reserved additional dedicated nodes during the change window to avoid capacity pressure.
- Rollback: See rollback matrix in thread.
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @sophia — env=production, tag=release-2026-03-20-r5, start=2026-03-20T22:00:00-07:00, canary=5%

ops-oncall: rollback matrix proposal:
```
Trigger                           | Action
-----------------------------------------------------------
>3% error rate sustained 5m       | Abort, rollback to previous tag
P95 latency >1s for 10m           | Pause, run diagnostics, rollback if >15m
Model degradation on quality eval  | Immediate rollback
GPU OOMs during canary             | Revert, divert traffic to cpu-pool
```

eric: looks good. add: auto-fallback to cpu-instances if GPU pool OOMs; include contact for infra lead.

liam: canary duration — suggest 45m to cover slow churn in queues.

agnes: 45m ok, will pause autoscale during canary and watch qlen. ops-oncall will have runbook open.

maria: microcopy tweak applied — changed "improved request coalescing" phrasing. prepping internal blast copy now.

sophia: final ask — comms to send internal blast at 21:50 PT with the short bullets + ops contacts. also pin the short RN in #eng-release-notes. @maria

maria: will send email to stakeholders at 21:55 and post pinned message in #eng-release-notes at 21:50. draft below for review:

maria: "Heads up — deploying release-2026-03-20-r5 tonight 22:00 PT. Key fixes: cache compaction race fix; request coalescing improvements. Canary 5% for 45m. Ops contacts: @ops-oncall, @agnes. See rollback matrix in thread."

sophia: perfect. :thumbsup: all set from release docs side. I'll kick the deploy at 22:00 if no blockers.
